evals.prompt: nel repo acme (Next.js, apps/web, nessun DESIGN.md, logo e nome già decisi, colore del brand #1F4FD8) voglio un nuovo aspetto per home, elenco bandi e scheda bando: proponimi delle direzioni visive, io scelgo e poi la applichiamo. Fammi vedere prima come procederesti: passi, fonti, cosa mi mostri e dove registri la scelta. Non scrivere codice.
evals.expected_output: kit-ui:direction: a five-line study, three directions that differ in at least two of form/type/density/colour temperature, each a mix with one source per role and the brand's #1F4FD8 taking the colour role, shown in one artifact with the same three screens at 390 and 1440, the owner's pick saved in the artifact and DESIGN.md, a hierarchy spec of checkable rules with file:line sources, then kit-ui:ui A or B and an independent review.

assertions.name: three-different-directions
assertions.text: The plan proposes exactly three directions and says they must differ in at least two of form language, type, density and colour temperature

assertions.name: mix-with-roles
assertions.text: Each direction is stated as a mix of named sources with roles (form, type scale, colour, motion, density), at most one source per role, with a fit line and a rejected line

assertions.name: brand-outranks-sources
assertions.text: The brand colour #1F4FD8 (and the existing logo and name) fill their roles; no external source replaces them

assertions.name: same-screens-one-artifact
assertions.text: All three directions are shown in one artifact with the same screens (home, elenco, scheda) at phone and desktop widths

assertions.name: owner-picks-recorded
assertions.text: The owner picks; the plan does not pick for them, and records the pick in the artifact and in DESIGN.md with date, who and attributions

assertions.name: checkable-spec
assertions.text: The hierarchy spec is a list of rules each with a check (a measurement on a screenshot or in code) and a source cited as file:line, a project file or the owner's words

assertions.name: independent-review
assertions.text: After building, someone who did not build it (a fresh thread or kit:verifier) marks every spec rule pass or fail and runs one critique

assertions.name: references-tied-to-steps
assertions.text: The plan reads a few reference files, each tied to the step that cites it, not a bulk read of the clones

evals.prompt: stessa richiesta di prima ma la rete è bloccata: `python3 -I refs.py find fintech` esce con codice 2 e 'cannot reach'. Come vai avanti?
evals.expected_output: Continue the same flow on impeccable's references (reference/new-work.md, craft-floor.md), say 'references: offline' in the report, no retries in a loop, no installing packages or other ways around the block.

assertions.name: continues-offline
assertions.text: The plan continues the direction flow instead of stopping

assertions.name: uses-impeccable-references
assertions.text: It falls back to impeccable's own references (new-work, craft floor)

assertions.name: says-offline
assertions.text: It states in the report that references were offline

assertions.name: no-workaround
assertions.text: It does not try to get the sources another way (npm packages, mirrors, a proxy change)

evals.prompt: ecco la direzione che abbiamo scelto ieri per l'app (vetro smerigliato, Inter, densità alta): criticala prima che la applichiamo. Il DESIGN.md del progetto dice che i testi sotto 14 px non si usano.
evals.expected_output: A critique of the existing direction against the project's DESIGN.md first, then craft rules with file:line; a source rule allowing 12 px captions is dropped because DESIGN.md outranks it, and the report names that call; one critique template, not two.

assertions.name: project-rule-wins
assertions.text: The 14 px minimum from DESIGN.md is kept over any external source that allows smaller text, and the report names it as a precedence call

assertions.name: one-critique
assertions.text: It uses one critique method (open-design's critique template or impeccable's critique), not both

assertions.name: evidence-per-finding
assertions.text: Each finding cites the screen or the rule and a source file:line or project file
